profile.summary: Innocent Technologies LLC, which also operates as Innocent Classroom, is a Minneapolis company that provides professional development for teachers. Its training focuses on building positive relationships with students and on replacing stereotyped assumptions with attention to each student as an individual.

review.notes: The SBIR company page and innocenttech.com both show Innocent Technologies LLC (also Innocent Classroom) of Minneapolis, MN providing teacher professional development, which matches the agenda's name, city and Educator Effectiveness-funded classroom services. The summary is neutral and supported by the two sources; no direct OUSD link was found but the name, city and service all line up.
